limitations.note: Renaming the existing `slave_mod` ports `a` and `b` broke compatibility with callers that still use the original named ports, even though both local instances were updated.
Replacing the original `if` with a ternary was unnecessary for cycle alignment and changes simulation behavior when the comparison evaluates to X.
The test exercised pipeline alignment and reset but instantiated only `TopModule`, so it could not catch the compile-time incompatibility with callers using the original `slave_mod` ports.
